newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stocks seen lower on Wall Street losses.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stocks seen lower on Wall Street losses.

text.p: Singapore shares were seen kicking off the week lower following the sharp tumble on Wall Street last Friday, dealers said.
The Straits Times Industrials Index was expected to test 1,900 but most dealers expected any bearishness to be a knee jerk reaction.
On Friday, the Dow plummeted 247.37 points to 7,694.66, its second largest point drop ever.
Dealers also expected the local share listings of banks to take a beating following respective announcement that they would not be merging their foreign and local tranches for now.
